verdict.rationale: Poke's release notes explicitly state it can 'share images of existing data (like spreadsheets) for Poke to extract and visualize,' showing some image-interpretation capability, but this is limited to structured data extraction rather than general photo/screenshot understanding across varied content. Missing for 10: evidence of accurate interpretation of arbitrary photos/screenshots (e.g., UI screenshots, handwritten notes, general scenes), independent hands-on verification of accuracy, and any first-party documentation describing general vision/OCR capability beyond the spreadsheet example.
